text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Digital-chan! I made a new fan 
for today's idol fest♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooooohhh! Handmade by Falco-san herself!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's so overflowing with love for your 
oshi, it's super wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right!! Do you get it!? I just 
wanted to send Falco's feelings to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely!! You just want to 
let them know that their fans are here 
supporting them, right?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Plus, performing at a festival 
is huge, so I really want you to give it 
your all!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've received so much energy and courage 
from their performances up until now... So 
today, I'm going to give them strength 
with my cheering!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san...!! So precious... so 
precious...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Digital-chan, does somewhere hurt?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I was just purified by the sheer 
preciousness! I'm completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thank goodness! It would've sucked 
so bad if I couldn't go to the festival~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Both my condition and preparations are 
perfect!! I've overcome every obstacle to 
make sure I'm in top shape to meet the 
Umadols!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha, as expected~! Well, should we get 
going soon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's a familiar racecourse, but the 
atmosphere feels so different~. I want to 
perform at a live festival here someday 
too...

text_block_list.name: Falco & Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah... Eeeeeeeeeeek!! Whoa! Waaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Falco & Digital
text_block_list.text: Let me hear it! Woo-hoo! LOVE LOVE LOVE!!

text_block_list.name: Falco & Digital
text_block_list.text: And hit! And hit! And hit! And hit!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I don't wanna go back to reality yet! 
Hey, Digital-chan, wanna have an 
after-party in the dorm!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure I may join you?! I-I-In that 
case, how about we watch some concert 
discs and review the setlists together!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I love that idea~♪ Let's wave penlights 
too☆ This festival is far from over~!"
